title: Jurassic World Evolution 2
shortDescription: Jurassic World Evolution 2 is the much-anticipated sequel to Frontier’s highly successful Jurassic World Evolution. This bold new era in the Jurassic World Evolution game franchise builds upon the ground-breaking and immersive 2018 management simulation.
zhShortDescription: 建造并管理恐龙主题公园，培育基因改造的史前生物。
description: Jurassic World Evolution 2 is the much-anticipated sequel to Frontier’s ground-breaking 2018 management simulation, Jurassic World Evolution, offering an all new narrative campaign voiced by cast members from across the Jurassic World film franchise, exciting new features, four engaging game modes, and an expanded roster of awe-inspiring dinosaurs. Learn what it takes to be a park management master in Campaign mode, a compelling, original narrative that puts you at the heart of the action following the earth-shattering events of Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. metaDescriptionEn: Jurassic World Evolution 2 review — dinosaur park management. Enclosure design, dino breeding, guest management.
metaDescriptionZh: 《侏罗纪世界进化2》Steam 评测与介绍 — 恐龙公园经营管理。围场设计、恐龙培育、游客管理。

topReviews.review: Building and managing your own dinosaur park is still incredibly enjoyable, especially once the chaos starts and everything inevitably breaks loose. The variety of dinosaurs, biomes, and customization options makes it easy to sink hours into perfecting your parks. Chaos Theory mode is a great addition for fans of the movies, and watching your dinos interact stays entertaining even after dozens of hours. The management systems can feel a bit repetitive later on, but if you like park builders and dinosaurs, this is an easy recommendation.
topReviews.zh_review: 建造和管理自己的恐龙公园依然超级好玩，尤其是当混乱开始、一切不可避免地失控时。恐龙种类、生物群落和自定义选项的丰富程度让人轻松沉浸数十小时。混沌理论模式对电影粉丝是极好的补充，看你养的恐龙互动即使玩了几十小时也依然有趣。管理系统后期可能变得有些重复，但如果你喜欢公园建造和恐龙，轻松推荐。
